title: AI innovative solutions to help improve the member experience
summary: Newsroom article describing five AI-enabled tools UnitedHealthcare and Optum use to improve the member experience: Smart Choice, Members Like You, conversational AI, claims assistant and advocate tools.

atoms.title: AI to simplify benefits and coverage
atoms.question: How is UnitedHealthcare using AI to improve the member experience?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare says it works with its partners at Optum to use artificial intelligence (AI) to take some of the complexity out of health care when consumers need to know about their benefits and coverage. It describes five ways: Smart Choice provider search, Members Like You cost estimates, Conversational AI, a claims assistant and advocate tools.
questions: What AI tools does UnitedHealthcare offer members?
How does UnitedHealthcare use AI for benefits?

atoms.title: Smart Choice personalized search preferences
atoms.question: What preferences can I set in Smart Choice provider search?
atoms.text: Smart Choice, available on the UHC app, uses Optum's AI capabilities to show results that reflect personalized search preferences. Members can set criteria such as distance, language spoken, virtual or in-person appointments, gender preference, and availability for evening and weekend appointments.
questions: Can I search for a doctor who speaks my language?
How does Smart Choice personalize doctor search?

atoms.title: Four Smart Choice matching standards
atoms.question: How does Smart Choice match members with providers?
atoms.text: Four key standards are used to match members with a provider. Quality covers factors such as credentialing and whether physicians meet UnitedHealth Premium care criteria. Benefits covers the member's health plan benefits. Convenience covers where providers have appointments available, virtual or in-person, and their proximity. Personal fit covers how a provider matches personal preferences.

atoms.title: Members Like You cost estimates
atoms.question: What is the Members Like You feature?
atoms.text: In the UnitedHealthcare app, the Members Like You cost estimates feature shows general and anonymous demographic information, like gender and age, to suggest the types of services commonly used by other members on a similar care journey. The insights come with cost estimates meant to help members understand potential out-of-pocket costs and avoid surprises.

atoms.title: Conversational AI voice assistant
atoms.question: How does UnitedHealthcare's conversational AI voice assistant work?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare's conversational voice assistant converses in natural language to understand the reason for a call. It decides how best to support the caller by routing them to provider, enrollment or benefit information, either through self-service or by transferring to a live advocate. The article states the AI does not give verbal answers to member questions.

atoms.title: Claims assistant cuts submission time
atoms.question: How does the Claims Assistant AI tool help with out-of-network claims?
atoms.text: The Claims Assistant AI tool supports out-of-network claim submissions by simplifying the process and helping to populate the medical field values. It cuts the time to complete an out-of-network claim submission from 12-15 minutes down to 3 minutes, and completion rates have nearly doubled as a result.

atoms.title: AI tools that support advocates
atoms.question: How does AI support UnitedHealthcare advocates on calls?
atoms.text: AI tools help advocates answer questions about health benefit navigation, coverage information or costs. The Welcome experience provides member insights based on claims activity or previous calls before the call. In-call assist uses voice analytics to understand needs and provide benefits, coverage and cost answers. In-call summarization summarizes the conversation for the member's file so callbacks go faster.
